You ask what’s behind the door and Keh replies, “Nothing!”
Somehow, you don’t believe him. To pull out your gun and 
threaten Keh to show you what’s behind the door, go to 370. 
Or you can leave: either return to 206, or to any Cairo location 
on the Egypt Location Table.
